Notes: The samples cover the regions and 2017--2019 entering cohorts contributing treated observations to Table~\ref{tab: ninth grade composition}. Lottery applicants are retained when every over-demanded school on their pre-lottery list, including automatic continuity options, belongs to a supported region-cohort. No restriction uses the realized offer or school attended. Columns (1) and (2) use the same observed-characteristic sample and retain hundredth propensity-score groups containing both offer arms; this excludes 477 applicants for GPA and 481 for income after removing missing characteristics. Column (1) uses the complier-profile estimator described in Appendix~\ref{app:ninth-grade-composition}; heteroskedasticity-robust influence-function SE are in parentheses. Its $N$ is the estimation sample size, not a count of identified compliers. Columns (2) and (3) are student-weighted means. GPA is on the composition analysis's national prior-year scale; the lottery measure is converted using exact year-specific affine relationships in linked records. Low-income status is measured in the application year for applicants and compliers, and the entry year for entrants. These profiles describe different populations and do not identify the students whose access changed under SAE.
